name: Pavilion Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Pavilion Real Estate Investment Trust with the largest exposure to the retail sector by any listed Malaysian REIT, Pavilion REIT owns a RM9.1 billion portfolio based on appraised value, to which its most prominent assets are its retail malls, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur Mall and Pavilion Bukit Jalil. Pavilion REIT is established with the principal investment policy of investing, directly and indirectly, in a diversified portfolio of income producing real estate used solely or predominantly for retail purposes (including mixed use developments with a retail component) in Malaysia and other countries within the Asia-Pacific region.
